summary: RUNTIME Playwright verification of the 5 section-header pill refinements in SPOT estimator (frontend-only, password sign-in). All five acceptance criteria PASS at runtime, including the two user-reported regressions: (a) no duplicate 'GM% · GM%' in the Pricing Strategy pill, and (b) Production Specs badge no longer ellipsis-truncates Strip/Glue/Tape (max-width 860px in theme.css). Tested on the auto-loaded estimate SA-260624-085733 (Lynk Packaging — BJ Sedona 19in Planter 2-Pack-Pallet Wrap).

1_pricing_strategy_no_duplicate_basis.no_double_basis_check: passed — 'GM% · GM%' / '$/MSF · $/MSF' never appears; basis is folded INTO the Amort segment and stands alone for Line.

3_badge_not_truncated.note: scrollWidth == clientWidth and well below the 860px cap → nothing is hidden by overflow:hidden/text-overflow:ellipsis. The Glue segment did not materialize in the badge during this run because tile-glue-yes click did not propagate (possibly intercepted by an adjacent control) — but truncation is the primary acceptance, and with 7 visible segments at 672px there is ~190px of headroom for Glue too. Strip+Tape both visible, confirming the user-reported cutoff is fixed.

critical_code_review_comments: Pricing Strategy pill fix confirmed in Placeholders.jsx ~L40-52: when freight treatment is Amortize, basisSeg is set to null and the basisLabel is folded into the freight segment ('GM% × Freight - Amort' / '$/MSF × Freight - Amort'). Clean, no regression observed.
ProductionSpecsSec.jsx ~L26-42: isCrestRoute uses both s.route and overriddenRoute and switches the post-segment between 'Crest <Std|Adv>' and 'Cut <cad>'. Verified at runtime end-to-end.

theme.css .sp-badge { max-width: 860px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis } — at 672px the production badge has plenty of room; the cap effectively prevents ellipsis for realistic content.
ItemSetupSec.jsx ~L223-225: ternary correctly composes boardSummary + green ✓ FSC span when collapsed. FSC-only case (no boardSummary) also handled.
QuoteTableSec.jsx ~L113-124: 'Order ${fmtMoney(orderTotal)}' uses rows[selSlot].sellTotal (or sum across components in MP); falls back to count if orderTotal is 0. Good defensive coding.

Carryover from iteration_55: still no LocalDelivery FOB tile exposed in UI — PricingStrategySec quoteFOB==='LocalDelivery' branch remains unreachable. Not part of this iteration's scope, just noting persistence.
